title: The Shocking Downfall of Videocon 💔 Case Study | Who Destroyed Electronics Giant | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "The Shocking Downfall of Videocon 💔 Case Study | Who Destroyed Electronics Giant | Live Hindi"

Once upon a time, Videocon was one of India’s most trusted electronics brands — a company that ruled the market with its TVs, washing machines, refrigerators, and mobile phones. From middle-class homes to luxury apartments, every Indian household had at least one Videocon product.

But what went wrong? How did a brand once worth ₹30,000 crore collapse into bankruptcy?

In this detailed Videocon case study, we’ll explore the entire journey —
from its rise and success story under founder Venugopal Dhoot, to the mistakes, competition, and management failures that led to its shocking downfall.

You’ll understand how global competition from LG, Samsung, and Whirlpool, along with poor diversification decisions (like entering telecom and oil sectors), slowly destroyed a once-iconic Indian brand.

This video covers the full business story of Videocon —
its history, growth, leadership lessons, and the ultimate failure that changed India’s consumer electronics landscape forever.

If you’re an entrepreneur, business student, or brand strategy enthusiast, this Videocon rise and fall story will teach you priceless lessons about brand management, over-expansion, and staying relevant in a changing market.
